issue.title: Retry retryable ref-job clips with backoff before falling back

task_type_fields.proposal: Retry retryable capture clips before falling back (ref jobs v2). Today the bob ref jobs worker (src/native/ref_jobs/worker.rs) makes one attempt per job. Any IngestError, including retryable kinds (network, timeout, dependency, browser, and http_status 408/429/5xx), immediately writes the ⚠️ inbox-task fallback. A v2 would requeue retryable failures with bounded backoff, for example 3 attempts over a few hours, before falling back. It needs a design for the attempts/next_attempt_at fields in the job schema (additive, schema_version 1), how `bob ref jobs` and the doctor row show waiting retries, what triggers a later run (a kick, the Mac cron, or the next capture), and whether a fallback should still happen eventually.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-52 deliberately shipped one attempt in v1 (plan:202610/url_capture_ref_routing.md, design decision 12.7 and the Out of scope list). Its verify phase proposed this as a follow-up (bob-cli-52.9 note #4).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52 shipped single-attempt ref jobs on purpose and its verify phase proposed retries as the v2 follow-up (bob-cli-52.9 note #4).
